title: Acute/hospital clinical reasoning overlay for PhysioPath Jeffery
question: How should Jeffery's system prompt be improved for acute/hospital physical rehabilitation without making Jeffery a clinician?

claims.text: TEAM: extra early active mobilisation did not increase days alive and out of hospital at 180 days (143 vs 145, P=0.62) and increased mobilisation-attributable AEs (9.2% vs 4.1%).
AVERT: very early frequent higher-dose out-of-bed mobilisation reduced odds of favourable 3-month mRS 0-2 (46% vs 50%; aOR 0.73, 0.59-0.90).
Hodgson 2014: ETT is not a contraindication; FiO2<0.6, SpO2>90%, RR<30 were consensus-safe if no other contraindications; no consensus on vasoactive dose.
Schaller 2024: start mobilisation within 72 h when no contraindication; stepwise to highest safe level; no evidence-based absolute start vitals.
SCCM PADIS 2025: conditional recommendation for enhanced mobilisation/rehabilitation over usual care (moderate certainty).
Masley 2011: acute-care PT reasoning integrates medical information with PT knowledge, dynamic assessment, mobility/safety, and discharge setting.
Mari 2024 SRMA: EM within 72 h associated with shorter ICU LOS and MV duration, better strength/function, no increase in AEs or mortality (conflicts with TEAM on AEs).

writing_context: PhysioPath is educational; overlay must not diagnose or replace in-person care.
Engine already has icu_aw, stroke/raised_icp, venous_rehab, encephalopathy, sternal/abdominal/spinal, telemetry, acute-track RPE 9-12.
